context: M3 o8. Back at the cab line. Delroy counts the meter money on the fender.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: Three fares, no dents, and the lady from Chelsea tipped a dollar? You're hired.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: Fourteen for you. Come back any night. The cab don't sleep and neither do you.

lines.speaker: char.delroy_tate
lines.text: Hey. Saw Carl Mayhew at the stand Friday. Asking who drives nights. Funny, huh?
